sentences.en: If you climb up this mountain, you'll reach the lab.
sentences.zh: 如果你爬到这座山的山顶，就能到达实验室。

sentences.en: I heard them say something had happened in the lab.
sentences.zh: 我听到他们说实验室里发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Detective Dan Anderson waited anxiously for the crime lab results.
sentences.zh: 侦探丹·安德森焦急地等待着犯罪实验室的结果。

senses.zh: 实验室，研究室,Lab,英国政治工党,分析室,暗室
